learning_objective: 🎯 Give your plain HTML websites a beautiful makeover! Learn how to control colors, fonts, and layouts using CSS.

सेलेक्टर (HTML तत्व जिसे स्टाइल करना है)

main_concepts.simple_explanation: If HTML is the skeleton (structure) of a website, CSS is the skin, clothes, and makeup! It describes how HTML elements should be displayed on screen in terms of color, spacing, and layout.

1. Inline: Written directly inside the HTML tag (using `style=""`). 2. Internal: Written in the `<head>` section inside `<style>` tags. 3. External: Written in a separate `.css` file and linked to the HTML.
A CSS rule has two main parts: a Selector and a Declaration block. Example: `h1 { color: blue; font-size: 20px; }`. Here, `h1` is the selector, `color` is the property, and `blue` is the value.
Every HTML element is essentially a box. The Box Model consists of: Content (the text/image), Padding (space inside the border), Border (the line around it), and Margin (space outside the border).

fun_activity.title: 🎨 The Instant Makeover
fun_activity.instructions: In your HTML file, add this inside the `<head>` tag: `<style> body { background-color: black; color: green; font-family: monospace; } </style>`. Refresh your browser, and instantly your page will look like a hacker's computer screen from a movie!

exam_tips: 📌 External CSS is the best method because it keeps the HTML clean and allows you to change the look of an entire website by editing just one CSS file.
📌 ID selectors use a hash `#` (e.g., `#header`), while Class selectors use a period `.` (e.g., `.highlight`). IDs must be unique, classes can be reused.
📌 CSS declarations must always end with a semicolon `;`.
quick_recap: ⭐ CSS stands for Cascading Style Sheets.
⭐ `background-color` changes the background, while `color` changes the text color.
⭐ The Box Model is crucial for understanding how spacing and layout work on the web.
